summary: Agnes Neves of Lavenham, also known as Agnes Payne; John's 12th-great-grandmother.
bio: Agnes Neves, also known as Agnes Payne, lived at Lavenham. She wrote her will in 1635, and it was proved in 1646, so she died at some point between those two years. She was John's 12th-great-grandmother.
